name: Пастки: ловля фігури й відкритий напад (1)

examples.text:
White can attack the bishop with both 1.d4 and 1.f4.

1.f4 (red arrow) opens up the king position and that immediately causes White problems. With 1…Bd4+, black has a deadly discovered attack.

1.d4 does win a piece since the bishop cannot be removed with a gain in tempo (there is no check similar to the check after 1.f4).

texts: Attack a pinned piece again. Make the right choice.
